mapper.insert: insert into clazz(name, room, begin_date, end_date, master_id, stage, create_time, update_time) values(#{name}, #{room}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{masterId}, #{stage}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select c.id, c.name, c.room, c.begin_date as beginDate, c.end_date as endDate, c.master_id as masterId, c.stage, c.create_time as createTime, c.update_time as updateTime, e.name as masterName from clazz c left join emp e on c.master_id = e.id order by c.update_time desc, c.id desc
select c.name as name, count(s.id) as num from clazz c left join student s on c.id = s.clazz_id group by c.id, c.name order by c.id
